description: With the hub unreachable (`hubConnected:false`) and no pending local writes, the header SaveStatus reads "Saved locally · synced" (seen at 1 s, 5 s and 15 s). The switcher reads "Saved locally · waiting for hub" at the same time. After the hub returns, the header says synced but the switcher still says waiting for hub.
expected: While the hub is unreachable, show "Saved locally · hub unreachable" (or "waiting for hub") in every surface, and refresh the switcher label on reconnect.
actual: The header claims synced during an outage, and the switcher stays stale after recovery.
suggested_fix: Derive SaveStatus from hubConnected as well as syncPending, and feed the open project's switcher label from the same live status.

description: In the Invite dialog during a hub outage, "Invitations for this project" shows "Loading…" indefinitely. It never shows a failure or a retry, even after the dialog is closed and reopened.
expected: "Can't list invitations while the project's hub is unreachable." with a Retry.
suggested_fix: Handle the list request's rejection and render the HUB_UNAVAILABLE hint used by Create invitation.

description: The invitation failure heading is the raw server message "Project authority unavailable; retry this attempt". The friendly hint below it says the same thing better.
expected: Use the hint as the message ("The project's hub is unreachable…") and drop the jargon heading.
actual: A jargon heading above the hint.
suggested_fix: When a JOIN_HINTS-style hint exists, show it as the heading and keep the code for diagnostics.

description: During the outage Tomás's own You avatar and profile read "Offline" (Live sessions 0) while he is actively editing. Six seconds after the hub returned, all avatars, including his own, were still grey.
expected: His own presence shows Active locally, with a note that teammates' presence is unavailable.
actual: He is shown Offline to himself.
suggested_fix: Render the local Actor's presence from the local session when remote presence is unavailable.

description: Each member's client contributes a "Setup agent". The header shows two or three identical "SA" avatars that cannot be told apart.
expected: Agent avatars name their owner, such as "Tomás's Setup agent".
suggested_fix: Qualify agent display names with the sponsoring person.

description: "@dana this blocks the 3.2 release" posts as plain text with no chip and no notice that @dana matched nobody, so Tomás believes Dana will be notified.
expected: An inline warning that @dana matches no Actor, with a suggestion of Dana Whitfield.
suggested_fix: See flag #15: resolve display-name mentions or warn before posting.
